खुर् खुर्, cl. 6. P. खुरति, चुखोर, खो-
रितुम्, to cut, cut up, break in pieces; to
scratch; [cf. क्षुर्.]

खुर खुर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. the last),
a hoof, a horse's hoof, &c.; a sort of perfume, com-
monly called Nakhi, apparently a dried shell-fish
shaped like a hoof [cf. कोलदल]; a razor; the foot
of a bedstead [cf. क्षुर].
—खुर-क्षेप, अस्,
m. a kick with a hoof, kicking.
—खुर-णस्, आस्,
आस्, अस्, or खुर-णस, अस्, आ, अम्, having a nose
like a horse's hoof, flat-nosed.
—खुर-पदवी, f.
a horse's foot-marks.
—खुराघात (˚र-आघ्˚) or
खुराभिघात (˚र-अभ्˚), अस्, m. a kick, kicking
(as of a horse).

खुरक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = तिल; a kind
of dance.

खुराक खुराक, अस्, m. an animal in gene-
ral; (perhaps originally ‘an animal with hoofs,’
खुर ?).

खुरप्र खुरप्र, अस्, m. an arrow with a
semicircular head; (a wrong form for क्षुरप्र.)

खुरली खुरली, f. military exercise, prac-
tising archery, &c.; [cf. खलूरिका.]
खुरालक खुरालक, अस्, m. an iron arrow.

खुर्द् खुर्द्, cl. 1. A. खूर्दते, to play,
to sport, = कुर्द्, गुर्द्, q. v.
